easy.statement_latex: Find the exact value of $\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)$. Give your answer in the range $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\ \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$.

Find the angle in $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\ \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$ whose sine equals $\frac{1}{2}$.
